name: Devoted Bloomweaver: [Class Bonus] On Enter, Empower 2
notes: Devoted Bloomweaver is a TERA (advanced element) ALLY with a MAGE Class Bonus On Enter, same split as vernal-talisman-preserve-draw: the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real TERA champion (Kongming, Fel Eidolon) for element access, and that same champion is ALSO physically seeded onto the field so IsClassBonusActive(['MAGE']) -- which scans physical field objects, independent of the Subcards-based lineage check -- is satisfied. Empower() (GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php:18438) has no stored counter of its own; it tags the champion's TurnEffects with the source card ID plus EMPOWERED/EMPOWER_PLUS_N, which is what's asserted here. The Preserve keyword (dies -> material deck preserved) is a separate, out-of-scope passive.
